description_en: Queries information about all queues in a vhost on a specified ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance
description_zh: 查询指定云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例下某一Vhost内的所有Queue信息
name: ListQueues

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The token that marks the end of the current query. Pass this token in the next call to retrieve the next page of results. The value is an empty string for the first call or when the last page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 用来标记当前查询结束的位置，以便下一次调用时作为参数传入，继续翻页。首次调用或返回最后一页时，取值为空字符串
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return
parameters.name: max_results
